invariants.schema_enforcement: Independent source and grain-specific proof shapes
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Reconstruct each source independently without substitution

invariants.schema_enforcement: Signed 64-bit integer primitives and floating-point rejection
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Checked arithmetic rejects overflow before aggregation

invariants.schema_enforcement: Closed currency domain on every record and proof key
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Cross-currency source sets fail admission without a proof

invariants.schema_enforcement: Canonical timestamp and digest field shapes
invariants.runtime_enforcement: UTF-8, NFC, ordered-key canonicalization and digest exclusions

invariants.schema_enforcement: Every family contains its complete source-identity components
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Same identity and digest is replay; changed digest is conflict

invariants.schema_enforcement: Transaction key and txn-prefixed proof/case structures
Closed event taxonomy and exact policy sign map
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Apply the policy sign to each positive raw amount

invariants.schema_enforcement: Capture forbids a reference and negative events require one
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Resolve exact capture, forbid chains and enforce cumulative capacity

invariants.schema_enforcement: Required namespace, entry type, postings and exclusive grain key
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Unique line identifiers, one currency and balanced positive totals

invariants.schema_enforcement: Transaction clearing role and debit/credit signs are frozen
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Compute clearing debits minus clearing credits

invariants.schema_enforcement: Settlement key and stl-prefixed proof/case structures
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Canonical settlement-key digest and uniqueness-domain checks

invariants.schema_enforcement: Five components, reported net and exact policy formula are required
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Recompute net and preserve formula mismatch as a financial exception

invariants.schema_enforcement: Settlement clearing and bank side signs are frozen
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Compute clearing credits minus debits and signed bank movement

invariants.schema_enforcement: Reference, permitted-account and allocation policies are explicit
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Exact normalized allocation, ambiguity rejection and no double use

invariants.schema_enforcement: Status-specific closed reason shapes and non-negative tolerances
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Apply tolerance only to complete semantically valid evidence

invariants.schema_enforcement: Mutually exclusive transaction and settlement totals and counts
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Recompute deltas, maximum difference, key and proof identity

invariants.schema_enforcement: Revision-one and predecessor-linked shapes plus actor restrictions
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Sequential append-only histories and immutable prior bytes

invariants.schema_enforcement: Authoritative proofs and cases admit only financial reasons
invariants.runtime_enforcement: Admission and execution failure cannot finalize authoritative output
